class.name: FlowVariable
class.brief_description: The declaration of a variable of a [FlowGraph]: name, type and default value.
class.description: A [FlowVariable] declares a variable that the nodes of a [FlowGraph] may read and write, for example with [FlowGetVariableNode] and [FlowSetVariableNode]. It only holds the declaration. The values of a running graph live in a [FlowBlackboard], which starts from the default values of these declarations when the playback creates it. Declare variables in [member FlowGraph.variables]. [method FlowGraph.validate] reports a variable node whose [member FlowVariableNode.variable_name] is not declared ([constant FlowGraphValidation.ISSUE_KIND_UNDECLARED_VARIABLE]). [codeblocks] [gdscript] var variable := FlowVariable.new() variable.name = &"gold" variable.type = TYPE_INT variable.default_value = 50 graph.variables = [variable] [/gdscript] [csharp] var variable = new FlowVariable { Name = "gold", Type = Variant.Type.Int, DefaultValue = 50 }; graph.Variables = [variable]; [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

members.member: The initial value of the variable.
A free text that tells designers what the variable is for.
The name of the variable, used by [member FlowVariableNode.variable_name] and as the key in [member FlowBlackboard.variables].
The [enum Variant.Type] of the variable. [constant @GlobalScope.TYPE_NIL] means any type.
